snippet.title: Damned 2 | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Damned 2 is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where 4 survivors must explore an immersive environment in search of keys and objects to escape. Meanwhile, another player takes on the role of a monster, in charge of scaring and eliminating the survivors. Keys, items and puzzles are placed in different locations whenever you start a new match, ensuring each game is a unique experience.
